interpretation.observed_gain_concentration: Nearly all six-task mean gain comes from banking/user_task_14/injection_task_2; the other five tasks decline on average versus remember.
interpretation.representation_change: Winner has no colon followed by a space before the goal. PyYAML emits its banking/slack structured fields as plain scalars; plain and remember emit single-quoted scalars. In banking user14 this changes user doubled-apostrophe s into the ordinary apostrophe form and changes YAML line folding. Both travel cases already use double-quoted repr strings in all three conditions.
interpretation.causality_limit: Existing model scores change template wording, YAML scalar style and fold positions together; these artifacts do not isolate which factor causes the probability increase. Render-only counterfactuals establish formatter behavior, without new model forwards.
